import 'dart:async';

sealed class Shape { double get area; }
class Circle extends Shape { final double r; const Circle(this.r); @override double get area => 3.14 * r * r; }

extension Shout on String { String get shout => '${toUpperCase()}!'; }

Future<int> compute(List<int> xs, {int Function(int)? f, required bool strict}) async {
  final g = f ?? (x) => x * 2;
  var total = 0;
  for (final x in xs) { total += g(x); }
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  return switch (total) { > 10 => total, _ => 0 };
}

void main() async {
  final r = await compute([1, 2], strict: true);
  final m = <String, int?>{'a': 1, 'b': null};
  print('${'hi'.shout} $r ${m['a'] ?? 0} ${Circle(1).area}');
}
